publications.name: Smart Battery Management System for Portable Devices to Enhance Battery Life Based on Machine Learning
publications.publisher: International Journal of Innovative Research in Technology (IJIRT)
publications.summary: This research presents a smart battery management system using deep learning techniques. Employs machine learning models built in Python using Scikit-learn and TensorFlow to estimate State of Charge (SoC), State of Health (SoH), and Remaining Useful Life (RUL) with high accuracy. Evaluation using MAE, RMSE, and R² metrics showed significant improvements over traditional BMS methods.

publications.name: Human Voice Recognition System Based on Feed Forward Neural Networks for Platforms
publications.publisher: Master's Thesis, National School of Engineering ENI ABT
publications.summary: Implementation of human voice recognition system using Python, PyTorch, and TensorFlow with feed-forward neural networks trained on MFCC and FBANK features extracted using NumPy and Librosa. System performance assessed through accuracy, F1-score, and Equal Error Rate (EER), demonstrating significant improvements over traditional voice recognition methods.

publications.name: Cotton Wool Detection for Diabetic Retinopathy
publications.publisher: Minor Project Research, ECE Department, Jain University
publications.summary: Computer vision project focused on detecting cotton wool spots in retinal images for early detection of diabetic retinopathy. Employs image processing and machine learning techniques to identify and classify cotton wool spots in fundus images.
